description: The philosophical and dramatic conflict behind the Ancients’ noninterference doctrine, from Kheb and Velona to Daniel, Abydos, Anubis, Oma Desala and the Ori.

related_resources.reason: Kheb, Harcesis, Daniel’s promise and the introduction of Oma Desala.
Shifu’s dream warning about extraordinary knowledge.
Orlin, Velona, collective intervention and the consequences of giving a population a weapon.
Daniel’s radiation poisoning and his first ascension.
Jack’s torture and the ascended Daniel’s constraints.
Abydos, Daniel’s direct confrontation with Anubis and Oma’s action.
Oma, Jim, Anubis and the ascended collective’s rules.
Cross-episode doctrine, including punishment and exceptions.
The late-series Ori and Merlin/Morgan complications.
